title: MongolVibes
description: Mongolia's favorite chill SMP! Enjoy vanilla survival, a player economy, land claims, and Java/Bedrock crossplay.
body:
# MongolVibes SMP 🇲🇳

A Survival server dedicated to Mongolian players. We focus mainly on keeping the server lag-free and fair.

## Why play with us?

* **Active Community:** There are always people around to trade and play with.
* **Grief-Free:** Our land claiming system is very easy to use.
* **Economy:** Players can open their own shops and run auctions.
* **Events:** Fun and interesting events are hosted every 2 weeks.
* **Crossplay:** Supports both Java Edition and Bedrock (Mobile/Console).

*If you are looking for a long-term server to commit to, come join us!*

---

### 🔗 Links

* **IP:** `mnvibes.org`
* **Website:** [www.mnvibes.org](https://www.mnvibes.org)
* **Discord:** [dsc.gg/mnvibes](https://dsc.gg/mnvibes)
---

### 📌 Bottom line

Welcome to the MongolVibes family! We are not just another server you play for a week and forget; we are a passion project built on years of community history. We actually listen to what our players want, which is why we are currently running a Vanilla Survival experience focused on building an awesome community and a player-driven economy. You can grab your pickaxe and jump into version 1.21.x with us right now.

Surviving out there can be tough since we play on Hard Mode, meaning you can actually die from starvation and zombies will try to break down your doors. To keep everyone close enough to trade and interact, the world is contained within a 12,000 block border. When it comes to protecting your hard work, you can create a group and claim 16x16 chunks of land, and as the owner, you get to set your own rules for things like PvP and explosions. Even if you do not have a claim set up yet, you can instantly lock your chests, doors, and barrels just by putting a sign on them. Also, you do not have to yell at everyone to sleep anymore, because if just 50 percent of the players hop in bed, the night skips automatically.

Our economy is completely run by the community using our own currency, the MongolTugrug. You can earn money passively by fighting monsters, but the real wealth comes from trading on the Auction House, where your items stay up for sale even while you are offline. We also spiced up the vanilla gameplay with some really fun features. You will earn RPG-style stat boosts like extra health and strength just by doing everyday chores like farming and mining. We added instant tree chopping, proximity voice chat so you can talk to your neighbors naturally, and unique custom enchants at the enchanting table like Vein Miner and Bunny Hop. You can even show off your coolest items right in the chat or use fun commands to sit on your friend's head.

We just want a fair, fun place for everyone to hang out, so we use strict anti-cheat systems where hackers are permanently banned with zero warnings. Friendly trash talk is totally fine, but we do not tolerate hate speech, doxing, or item duping. If you love playing here, you can pick up lifetime ranks like LIGHT, HYPER, or BYPASS, which is perfect for peaceful builders since it makes you completely immune to player damage. To come hang out, Java players can connect using mnvibes.org, and Bedrock players can use the same IP with the port 19132. First-timers just need to register a password in chat to keep their accounts safe, and if you own a legit premium Minecraft account, you can enable auto-login to skip that step forever.
